artwork.prompt: Playlist cover artwork, square format, evocative rather than literal. A 2015-present cover. Medium: generative abstraction, fluid gradient mesh, no depicted object. Not a depiction — an abstract composition that only distantly evokes a woven textile at macro scale. Palette: chrome yellow, deep green, vermilion, black. Composition: non-representational, full bleed, edge-to-edge colour. No text, lettering, typography, watermarks, logos or signatures anywhere in the image.
